description: Machine-readable registry for Agent-driven OpenClip Rebuild V1 standalone tools.

conventions.agent_instruction: Use Rebuild_V1 when the user wants standalone Rebuild tools. Run each tool directly and use --check-dependencies-only before execution when inputs are uncertain. Registered tool script filenames use Tool ID-style PascalCase segments; short legacy ids 01, 02, 04, and 04_1 keep their ids but use descriptive script names.

tools.name: 01_Rebuild_SourcePackageLoad
run_when: user has generated Final Prompt
source and intent package should be refreshed
skip_when: trusted source_package.json and rebuild_intent.json already exist and user does not need refresh

estimated_runtime.basis: local JSON/file metadata collection plus Final Prompt normalization

tools.agent_notes: Clean SRT Phase 1 entrypoint. Use --task-id or --session-id to fetch Final Prompt from the OpenCrew database; writes source_package.json, rebuild_input_check.json, and rebuild_intent.json.

run_when: intent package is ready
frontend needs a shot-level rebuild plan
skip_when: trusted rebuild_shot_plan.json already exists and user does not need refresh

estimated_runtime.basis: one OpenCode LLM call over compact source package

tools.agent_notes: Clean SRT Phase 1 shot plan builder. Generates a UI-presentable shot plan only and preserves Analysis-aligned SRT in shot.reference.srt_text; it must not create asset tasks or render plans.

tools.name: 02_01_Shot_KeyframesRefresh
run_when: a shot has missing or too few reference.keyframes
the operator wants to backfill one shot without rebuilding the whole shot plan
skip_when: the shot already has enough trusted keyframes and no refresh is requested

estimated_runtime.basis: local JSON and filesystem keyframe selection only

tools.agent_notes: Standalone single-shot keyframe backfill tool. Use --task-id and --shot-id. It merges existing shot keyframes, source_package keyframes, Analysis pyscenedetect_scenes, and Analysis visual_candidates; dedupes by path/time; preserves existing frames by default; and fills first/middle/last coverage up to --target-count. Use --dry-run to inspect without writing or --replace to recompute the shot selection.

tools.name: 04_ShotPlan_AssetTaskBuilder

skip_when: trusted asset_tasks.json already exists after the latest keyframe save

estimated_runtime.basis: local JSON planning and deterministic keyframe-pair selection

tools.agent_notes: Planning only. Uses saved reference.keyframes from rebuild_shot_plan.json; does not execute ComfyUI, HyperFrames, ffmpeg, GPT, Gemini, or Bailian tasks. reuse_reference_clip is disabled unless explicitly requested for debug smoke tests. Rebuild_V1 copied standalone tool; dependency contract will be normalized during V1 hardening.

tools.agent_notes: Single-shot prompt asset builder. Reuses the OC-Rebuild Task bound OpenCode Session and run model. Produces regenerated image prompts, model-specific VEO/Wan/Sora video prompts, and prompt-driven asset task entries without executing generation. Rebuild_V1 copied standalone tool; dependency contract will be normalized during V1 hardening.

tools.name: 12_00_Shot_PlanD_ReplacementImagePromptBuild
run_when: Shot needs the unified final Image, TTS, and Video prompt package for each scene
skip_when: final_prompt_package.json already has prompt_package_version=final_v1 with tts_prompt plus image_prompt and video_prompt for every scene unless --force is set

tools.agent_notes: Run this Rebuild_V1 standalone file directly with exactly one --shot-id. It writes one unified final_prompt_package.json with fields: shot_id, updated_at, prompt_package_version, references.host_image, references.product_image, tts_prompt, tts_speed_notes, scenes[].scene_mark_id, scenes[].reference_image, scenes[].image_prompt, scenes[].video_prompt. scenes[].reference_image is the original source first/single keyframe from rebuild_shot_plan.json used to write the replacement-image prompt; the generated Scene first image is the downstream output at Assets/<variant_id>/<shot_id>/<scene_mark_id>/first.png. It requires host/product consistency references and a source first/single keyframe for every scene mark. If a scene has no source first/single keyframe, the tool returns status=blocked and does not generate draft prompts.

tools.name: 12_02_Shot_PlanD_CodexImageGenFirstFrameGenerate
run_when: Shot Plan D needs generated replacement first-frame images for every scene using Codex built-in image_gen
skip_when: Assets/<variant_id>/<shot_id>/<scene_mark_id>/first.png already exists for every scene unless --force is set

estimated_runtime.basis: Depends on Codex image_gen execution; prepare/import are local

tools.agent_notes: Python cannot directly call the Codex built-in image_gen skill. Run this tool in --mode prepare to create per-scene Codex image_gen jobs and prompt files from final_prompt_package.json. Codex should then call the built-in imagegen skill for each job using source first frame, host reference, and product reference. After each image is generated, run this tool in --mode import with --scene-mark-id and --generated-image to copy the result to Assets/<variant_id>/<shot_id>/<scene_mark_id>/first.png, write asset_manifest.json, and sync rebuild_shot_plan.json.

tools.name: 12_01_Shot_PlanD_TTSDrivenLipSyncVideoGenerate
run_when: Shot needs the standard TTS-driven active-video-model generation; Sync.so lip sync is only called when at least one Scene has a visible mouth/lip-sync task
skip_when: Assets/<variant_id>/<shot_id>/plan_d.mp4 exists and --force / --force-lipsync-refresh is not set

estimated_runtime.basis: One TTS request, one video generation request, one Sync.so lip-sync request

tools.agent_notes: Run this Rebuild_V1 standalone file directly with exactly one --shot-id. Final video is written directly as Assets/<variant_id>/<shot_id>/plan_d.mp4, not inside a plan_d folder. Video models are read from Connection config; lipsync config is read only when the Shot has at least one Scene requiring visible mouth sync. The timed prompt saved in plan_d_video_prompt_timed.txt/json is the exact prompt sent to the video model and is synced back into final_prompt_package.json.
